project_description: Builds a small number of deep, technically impressive open-source portfolio projects (not shallow AI-spam repos) to make Jasper's GitHub look genuinely strong -- publishing only with his approval.

milestones.title: Select strong portfolio project
milestones.description: Choose one substantial project from the wider portfolio (e.g., Space Game Engine, FaultLab, Exoplanet Hunter, scientific tools, systems software, AI infrastructure, engineering simulations) that is technically impressive and justifies a dedicated repository. Document the choice and rationale in a file like `docs/project-selection.md` at the repo root (create the repo first).

milestones.title: Define measurable completion criteria
milestones.description: Write a `docs/completion-criteria.md` file in the repo root that lists specific, measurable, verifiable completion criteria for the selected project (e.g., 'all tests pass', 'benchmark X achieves Y', 'setup works from clean clone'). Ensure criteria are concrete and testable by an automated agent.

milestones.title: Create private GitHub repository
milestones.description: Initialize a new private GitHub repository for the selected project (e.g., via `gh repo create <name> --private`). Set up the local git repo, add a `.gitignore`, and push the initial commit with the selection and criteria docs. The repo must be private; do not publish publicly yet.

milestones.title: Build core functionality
milestones.description: Implement the core functionality of the selected project in the repo's source directory (e.g., `src/`). Write real, non-trivial code that matches the project's purpose (e.g., a game engine loop, a fault-injection harness, an exoplanet detection algorithm). Ensure it compiles/runs and performs a meaningful task. Add a `README.md` with a brief overview.
milestones.verify: test -f README.md && test -d src && find src -name '*.py' -o -name '*.rs' -o -name '*.go' -o -name '*.ts' | grep -q .

milestones.title: Add comprehensive tests
milestones.description: Write a test suite for the core functionality in a `tests/` directory (or language-appropriate location). Tests must cover the main features and edge cases. Ensure tests can be run with a single command (e.g., `pytest`, `cargo test`, `go test`). Add a `Makefile` or script `run_tests.sh` to run them.

milestones.title: Add benchmarks where appropriate
milestones.description: Create a `benchmarks/` directory with reproducible benchmark scripts or binaries that measure the project's performance (e.g., FPS, latency, throughput, accuracy). Add a `benchmarks/README.md` explaining how to run them and what they measure. Ensure benchmarks run successfully.
milestones.verify: test -f benchmarks/README.md && test -d benchmarks && ls benchmarks/*.py benchmarks/*.rs benchmarks/*.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -q .

milestones.title: Produce demo and example usage
milestones.description: Create a `demo/` directory with a runnable demo or example that showcases the project's key features. Add a `demo/README.md` with step-by-step instructions and expected output. Ensure the demo runs successfully from a clean environment.
milestones.verify: test -f demo/README.md && test -d demo && ls demo/*.py demo/*.rs demo/*.sh 2>/dev/null | grep -q .

milestones.title: Perform code review and fix issues
milestones.description: Review the entire codebase for quality, correctness, and adherence to the project's design. Fix any bugs, improve code structure, and ensure consistency. Add a `docs/design-decisions.md` file documenting key design choices and trade-offs. Run the test suite again to confirm everything passes.

milestones.title: Improve documentation
milestones.description: Enhance the README with a strong overview, architecture docs in `docs/architecture.md`, setup instructions, limitations, roadmap, and reproducible results. Add a `LICENSE` file (choose an appropriate open-source license). Ensure all docs are accurate and complete.
milestones.verify: test -f README.md && test -f docs/architecture.md && test -f LICENSE && grep -q 'setup' README.md && grep -q 'roadmap' README.md

milestones.title: Verify clean setup elsewhere
milestones.description: Simulate a clean environment (e.g., in a fresh directory or container) and follow the setup instructions from the README to ensure the project builds and runs from scratch. Fix any issues found. Add a `docs/verification.md` file documenting the verification steps and results.

milestones.title: Prepare release and clean commit history
milestones.description: Ensure the git commit history is clean and meaningful (squash or reword as needed). Tag the release version (e.g., `v1.0.0`). Add a `CHANGELOG.md` summarizing changes. Ensure the repo is in a presentable state for potential publication.
milestones.verify: git log --oneline | head -n 5 | grep -q '.' && git tag | grep -q 'v' && test -f CHANGELOG.md

milestones.title: Ask Jasper for publication approval
milestones.description: Prepare a publication request for Jasper, including a summary of the project, its quality, and a link to the private repo. Present this request to Jasper and wait for his explicit approval before making the repo public. Do not publish without approval.
milestones.human_reason: Jasper must explicitly approve making the repository public, as per Project Forge's rules.

milestones.title: Publish repository publicly
milestones.description: After Jasper's approval, make the GitHub repository public (e.g., via `gh repo edit --visibility public`). Verify the repo is public and the README, docs, and code are accessible. Add a note in `docs/publication-request.md` confirming the publication date.
